                "Difficulty": "Easy",
                "ItemType": "MCQ",
                "ItemStyle": "single-select",
                "Stem": "Frontier asks how profit changes if material prices rise by 8%. Which response is most appropriate?",
                "Choices": {
                        "A": "Treat the price change as an internal control deficiency",
                        "B": "Use sensitivity analysis only after the fiscal year is closed",
                        "C": "Ignore the assumption because budgets cannot be revised",
                        "D": "Use sensitivity analysis to isolate the effect of changing one assumption while holding others constant"
                },
                "CorrectChoice": "D",
                "ExplanationCorrect": "Sensitivity analysis evaluates how changes in assumptions affect planned results.",
